regime_context: The detector shows a defensive/non-cyclical leadership cluster (Big Pharma, equal-weight healthcare, defensives, staples) that is eligible, durable, high-breadth, and heavily crowded. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market history (gate_helps: true), so the discipline has a drawdown-edge, but cross-sectional rank has no forward return edge. With track_record dir_accuracy at 0.41 (below coin-flip on direction), I default to low conviction and a defensive, durability-first stance — no high-conviction theses.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the defensive cluster (Big Pharma + staples + defensives) begins to fade in cohesion — the observable I am watching for is breadth on Big Pharma dropping below 0.8 or three consecutive days of PPH underperforming XLV; that would retire the defensive-leadership watch in favor of a confirmed handoff to an ineligible-but-rising challenger.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-ranked eligible theme with a strong durability_bar (0.84), maximum breadth (1.0), trend hurst_tag, and val_state 'confirming'. It sits inside the headline cluster and is trend-gated eligible. This is a durability/trend-gate continuation lean, not a momentum-return forecast. Crowding (1.46 z, crowded=true) caps enthusiasm and argues for modest stance only.
theses.dissent: Broad healthcare leadership is crowded and has already persisted; the one_narrative flag is false, meaning this is a broad defensive bid rather than a concentrated durable story — a mean-revert pullback in defensive beta would hit this leg hardest.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its 50-day average before the 30-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight staples is eligible, durable (0.80), trend-tagged, and high-breadth (0.879), consistent with a defensive rotation that the absolute-trend gate currently permits. It is the most crowded leg in the top cluster (crowding_z 1.89), which sizes down but does not fade under the guardrails.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding nearly two standard deviations above trend suggests most of the defensive shift may already be priced; late continuation in staples has historically been vulnerable to sharp mean reversion when rates or risk appetite turn.

falsifier.text: XLP underperforms SPY by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM tops the raw rank (1.712) but is ineligible (eligible false, durability_bar only 0.35, breadth 0.0). The detector explicitly frames rank as attention, not alpha, and the trend gate is the only validated leg — this theme fails the gate. Under discipline-not-prediction, an ineligible top-ranked theme is an avoid, not a chase.
theses.dissent: If the absolute-trend gate has a lag and this is the early stage of a fresh HBM breakout, avoiding it would miss the strongest momentum in the book.

falsifier.text: SMH closes in the top decile of its 60-day range AND the theme's durability_bar rises above 0.5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
